embedding_policy: Breast: exclude mt/hemoglobin/ribosomal/stress HVGs, preserve cycling genes; PBMC: existing HVGs
latent_method: HVG PCA; captures/sample proxies analyzed separately; no cross-donor integration or DE

parameters.ambient_rna_policy: Not assessed: upstream filtered author matrices lack empty droplets
parameters.annotation_policy: Breast canonical coarse compartments; T/NK combined because cytotoxic programs overlap and author major T label contains NK; fine labels unreviewed. Same-dataset author labels used only for evaluation.
parameters.qc_policy: Breast mixed-tissue capture/sample MAD tails with lower tails capped at p05, no PBMC mt cap or upper-count exclusion

thresholds.rationale: Sample/capture log1p lower MAD tails capped at observed p05 for mixed tissue; mt upper MAD tail without PBMC 5-25% bounds. Zero MAD disables that tail; no upper-count exclusion. Review loss by compartment and sensitivity before use.
